integrity: A fully stand-alone exact branch-and-bound checker and a 44-word explicit witness are included; independent mathematical or biochemical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for length-six DNA words with GC-count three, full cross-bifix avoidance, and reverse-complement closure; finite exhaustive graph proof, not an asymptotic statement.
title: Exact capacity of reverse-complement-closed GC-balanced non-overlapping DNA six-mers
